newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says new group to reach 20 pct margin in 2000.
newsitem.headline: P&U says new group to reach 20 pct margin in 2000.

text.p: The new life science group Amersham Pharmacia Biotech will reach an operating margin of more than 20 percent in 2000, Pharmacia Biotech said on Tuesday.

The new group will be created through the merger of Pharmacia Biotech and Amersham Life Science, the life science units of Swedish/U.S. drugs group Pharmacia & Upjohn and British health and science group Amersham International Plc, the companies said early on Tuesday.

"When the integration of both companies has been completed, we will be back at a very good operating margin, more than 20 percent," Pharmacia Biotech's chief executive Arne Forsell told a news conference.

Synergies are expected to be larger on the sales side than on the cost side, he said, adding that the 22 million sterling in income and cost synergies mentioned in the announcement only referred to cost synergies.
"We have not yet estimated the synergies on the sales side," Forsell said.

Amersham Life Science had sales of $271 million in the fiscal year 1996/1997 and an operating profit of $61 million, while the corresponding forecasted 1997 figures for Pharmacia Biotech are $444 million and $40 million, respectively.
